-    # contract in this repository, and a pull request that changes CLI
-    # behaviour must ship the skill update with it, so that update is exactly
-    # what needs reviewing. It is allowlisted below.
+    # .agents/skills/** is a CLI public contract and remains reviewable.
+    - ".agents/skills/**/*.md"
```
